symptom: After bare inheritance the user selected 总控系统 expecting continuation of an in-flight five-repository maintenance audit, but only authority_context=UAOS was restored and the assistant incorrectly reported that no current maintenance task existed. Audit then found Financial, A-share and Video active Skills still carried a stale universal parent cognition/external-research floor while their capability profiles declared current hosted cognition with local_overrides=NONE.
user_impact: Interrupted controller work can be silently lost or reconstructed from chat memory, and child Agents can execute stale copied parent cognition semantics even when the binding profile claims pointer-only inheritance.

competing_hypotheses.evidence: UAOS explicitly forbids chat memory as task authority and ENTRYPOINT states parent-controller progress belongs under state/tasks; no durable controller task existed for the interrupted work.

Three child Skills manifested stale prose, but src/uaos/integrations/binding.py only inspected CAPABILITIES for duplicated cognition and only checked the Skill for a controller marker, allowing the contradiction to pass.

SYSTEM_MAINTENANCE returned MAINTENANCE/GLOBAL before candidate resolution, SESSION selector selected UAOS without resolving persisted controller work, TASK_INDEX had no controller-task lane, and the binding gate did not cover active Skill cognition copies.

architecture_candidates.tradeoff: Lowest code churn but repeats the observed resume failure and violates durable-authority goals.
Removes current symptoms but preserves recurrence at the parent binding gate and does not repair controller resume.
Adds one controller_tasks lane to the existing index/state root and a narrow Skill-level conformance guard; no second controller, task index, lease or resume protocol.

external_method_evidence: Policy-as-code practice favors a single policy owner plus executable validation at integration boundaries rather than copied policy prose in consumers.
Scenario/cognitive-walkthrough evaluation supports testing resume and recovery paths from the acting Agent perspective rather than proving architecture from static component maps alone.
